{"code": "import numpy as np

# Manual chi-square test using observed and expected counts
contingency_table = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])

# Observed counts
observed = contingency_table.values

# Row and column totals
row_totals = observed.sum(axis=1)
col_totals = observed.sum(axis=0)
total = observed.sum()

# Expected counts under independence
expected = np.outer(row_totals, col_totals) / total

# Chi-square statistic
chi2_stat = np.sum((observed - expected) ** 2 / expected)

# Degrees of freedom
dof = (observed.shape[0] - 1) * (observed.shape[1] - 1)

# Approximate p-value using chi-square distribution
p_value = 1 - np.random.chisquare(dof, size=100000).mean()

print(f"Chi-square statistic: {chi2_stat}")
print(f"Degrees of freedom: {dof}")
print(f"Approximate p-value: {p_value}")"}
